  function cookieParser(cookieString) {
    if (!cookieString) return {};
    return cookieString.split(";").reduce(function(obj, pair) {
      const part = pair.trim();
      const separatorIndex = part.indexOf("=");

      if (separatorIndex < 1) return obj;

      obj[decodeCookiePart(part.slice(0, separatorIndex))] = decodeCookiePart(part.slice(separatorIndex + 1));

    const chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789";
    let result = "";
    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {

    const secure = document.location.protocol === "https:" ? "; Secure" : "";

  const TRACK_ID_KEY = "trackId";

  function safeGetTrackIdFromLocalStorage() {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem(TRACK_ID_KEY);
    } catch (e) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  function isValidTrackId(value) {
    return value != null && String(value).trim() !== "";
  }

  function simpleHash(value, seed) {
    var hash = seed || 5381;
    var i = value.length;
    while (i) {
      hash = (hash * 33) ^ value.charCodeAt(--i);
    }
    var hex = (hash >>> 0).toString(16);
    while (hex.length < 8) hex = "0" + hex;
    return hex;
  }

  function getWeakPhysicalDeviceHash() {
    try {
      var w = screen.width || 0;
      var h = screen.height || 0;
      var parts = [
        Math.max(w, h),
        Math.min(w, h),
        window.devicePixelRatio || "",
        screen.colorDepth || "",
        navigator.maxTouchPoints || "",
        navigator.hardwareConcurrency || "",
        navigator.deviceMemory || ""
      ];
      var raw = parts.join("|");
      return simpleHash(raw, 5381) + simpleHash(raw, 52711);
    } catch (e) {
      return "";
    }

    setCookie(TRACK_ID_KEY, fromLs);

    return createRandomString(15) + "." + Date.now();
